messages: maya: dropping a fresh compact-playground mock where the token counter is moved left of the prompt and actions are grouped on the right. attached. quick takes on wording and keyboard affordances? design-bot: uploaded image compact-move-left.png :framed_picture: sam: engineering: moving token chip left is fine but watch for wrap on small widths. token updates currently fire every 300ms; recommend throttle to 1s and use fixed-width container to avoid layout shift. shortcut request: let's add a keyboard shortcut (Ctrl+.) to stop stream — doable but need UX signoff. emily: copy notes: prefer action verb clarity. options: 'Halt' (short, heavy), 'Interrupt' (clear), 'Pause' (implies resume). if we add Ctrl+. as shortcut we should show it in a tooltip: "Halt (Ctrl+.)". also token microcopy: 'Tokens: 1,234' is acceptable for compact UI. liam: accessibility: if token chip moves position relative to the prompt, ensure focus order is preserved and token chip set aria-hidden=true with an sr-only announcer updated less often (completion/milestone). for keyboard shortcut announce binding in a help dialog; don't rely on SR announcements for every token update. also ensure color contrast for the chip and shortcut hint meets 4.5:1. ara: UX thought: moving token left makes it more discoverable but could be mistaken for a message meta. maybe add a tiny label or icon to differentiate. Also if we show a shortcut in tooltip, it should be customizable in settings later. maya: decision proposal: move token left but fixed-width + tiny "Tokens" label; primary action label = 'Halt' for visibility in compact UI; include optional tooltip showing "Halt (Ctrl+.)" and wire the shortcut; token sr-announcer updates on completion or every 100 tokens. sam: can implement throttle + fixed width + keyboard handler. PR will include a11y snippet: ```html Tokens: 1,234 Tokens used: 1234 ``` emily: i'll write copy keys: playground.stream.action_halt = "Halt"; playground.stream.hint_halt = "Halt (Ctrl+.)"; playground.stream.tokens_compact = "Tokens: {n}" liam: i'll add a11y test steps: keyboard shortcut binding test, focus order when token is left, screen reader behavior with sr-announcer, and contrast checks. maya: awesome. final: token left with label, fixed width and 1s debounce, primary label = 'Halt' with Ctrl+. shortcut hint, sr-only announcer on completion/100-token milestone, preserve partial output during regen. posting updated mock after PR lands. :thumbsup: design-bot: uploaded image compact-move-left-v2.png :framed_picture: sam: thanks opening PR and tagging the thread for review. emily: adding copy to i18n branch now. liam: QA checklist in docs, tagging accessibility for review. maya: closing this thread, will reopen if implementation diverges.
